text: One for the tracker: What is the ticket number for the gatehouse tablet freezing at Door 6 at Tansleigh Packaging?
reply_text:
The ticket is #88412. I replied to you in a thread on your message in #central-random.

Tobias posted it in #central-team on 2025-07-02. It's the Tier 2 escalation for the Door 6 gatehouse tablet at Tansleigh Packaging, which was freezing when scanning bill-of-lading barcodes. In the same thread he confirmed it was Tansleigh Packaging, not Tansley Parcel.

In my reply I also said not to confuse it with #8841. Tobias flagged that one yesterday in #central-random for the West yard Door 2 double-booking on his dealer account.

text: One for the tracker: What is the ticket number for the Eastbank receiving-door import at Marrow Agrisupply? Putting it in the weekly notes.
reply_text:
The ticket is PD-4821. I replied to you in a thread on your message in #central-random.

Hollis posted it in #central-team on 2026-06-09. It's the one with the Eastbank receiving-door import attached for Marrow Agrisupply. At the time it had an open problem: the import file labelled doors E1/E2, but their booking sheet used 01/02, and that had to be fixed before anyone reimported. Nothing since then in the channels you're in says whether it was fixed.
